input.new_string:
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build binary
        run: go build -o myapp .
      - name: Publish release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: myapp
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Log in to registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Extract Docker metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

content.text:
I added Docker build/push steps to `.github/workflows/release.yml`, using GitHub Container Registry (`ghcr.io`):

- `docker/setup-buildx-action`, `docker/login-action` (auth via the built-in `GITHUB_TOKEN`, needs `packages: write` permission which I added), `docker/metadata-action` (derives tags from the pushed `v*` tag), and `docker/build-push-action` to build and push the image.

Since no `Dockerfile` existed in the repo, I also added a minimal multi-stage one that builds the same `myapp` binary and copies it into a distroless base image, so the new steps actually work.
